theme: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

reports.title: Nadim Butt
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: Whilst the hospital sought a review of procedures and protocols the matter was not elevated to a serious untoward incident or root cause analysis where all matters including clinical and nursing decisions were reviewed and subjected to critical examination.
Despite the recognition that a consultant-led out of hours on-call rota is required for patients having undergone surgery, no such rota is yet in place.

reports.title: Stephen Oakes
categories: Hospital Death (Clinical Procedures and medical management) related deaths

concerns.quote: The product description used by Enteral was insufficient to enable the end user to clearly identify that the tube marketed as a carefeed size 14FR feeding and drainage tube would not operate as a 14Fr tube due to the restricting en-fit connector
Enteral sales marketing staff were not trained to recognise the new restriction in the bore of the tube and were consequently unable to advise the end user of the change
The Hospital Trust did not fully evaluate the size 14FR tube prior to replacing all previous drainage tubes (Ryles) with the carefeed 14Fr feeding and drainage tube
Nursing staff did not consider alternative action when the NG tubes were not adequately draining
There is no compulsory training of clinicians required to undertake root cause analysis
concerns.hazard: lack of mandatory root cause analysis training

concerns.quote: This was a joint inquest into the death of two patients who died in quick succession as a result of the Enteral 14F nasosgastric tube being used for decompression in an emergency situation
concerns.hazard: inadequate industry awareness of labeling issue

links.explanation: Both reports highlight deficiencies in the hospital's approach to root cause analysis, either by not elevating issues to RCA or by lacking compulsory training for clinicians to conduct RCA.
